subject: Fee help for Ava? Between jobs right now

triage.summary: Tanya Briscoe, mother of Ava Nguyen, asks for a scholarship or reduced Majors fee due to her January layoff and offers to volunteer at the snack shack to make up the difference — a financial hardship request that needs a human money decision.
triage.proposed_action: Forward to treasurer/club lead for a decision on a reduced fee or scholarship for Ava; acknowledge to Tanya that a human will follow up (do not commit to any fee reduction); note her offer to volunteer at the snack shack as part of the decision.

details.membership_status: appears to be an existing/returning member interested in Majors season
details.offers: volunteer work at snack shack every weekend in lieu of fees
details.reason: laid off in January 2025, financial hardship

policy_reason: Policy: intent 'hardship_waiver' requires human decision (money + empathy decisions always go to a human)
